Meta Test Description: This testcase performs register write-read verification for the Ethernet1 IP. It consists of two main phases: (1) Default value check (chk_rst_val) — iterates over 434 register addresses, reads each register via read_reg() and compares the read value against the expected default value from default_value_array, skipping registers that are not readable (read_mask_array == 0) or marked in skip_rst_array. (2) Write-Read check (chk_rd_wr) — iterates over 6 test patterns (0xffffffff, 0xaaaaaaaa, 0x55555555, 0x00000000, 0xA5A5A5A5, 0xffff0000), writes each pattern to all writable registers via write_reg(), then reads back via read_reg() and compares against an expected value computed using write_mask_array, read_mask_array, and default_value_array. Registers marked in skip_array or with zero write/read masks are skipped. A soft_reset_chk() function is defined but commented out in test_case(). The test calls finish(1) if any failures are detected (def_fail_cnt > 0 or wr_fail_cnt > 0), otherwise finish(0).

Meta Test Description: This testcase performs a basic Ethernet1 TX (transmit) operation. It configures MAC address registers for 4 DMA channels, sets up MAC packet filter (hash filter enabled, receive all), enables TX and RX in MAC configuration with full duplex mode, configures MTL TX queue operation modes (4096 bytes, store-and-forward) and quantum weights for 4 queues, enables MTL queue overflow/underflow interrupts, programs DMA system bus mode, preloads TX descriptors via preload_descriptor(), programs DMA TX descriptor ring lengths, list addresses, tail pointers, and channel controls for 4 channels, enables DMA channel interrupts, enables HSS autoreg Ethernet interrupts at address 0xE68C2058, then starts TX on DMA channel 0. The test then loops 10 times waiting for transfer complete interrupts (polling int_pend via while loop with wait_on(10)), resetting int_pend after each interrupt. An interrupt handler (Default_IRQHandler) clears int_pend, reads current TX descriptor and buffer pointers for all 4 DMA channels, reads and prints DMA interrupt status, clears individual DMA channel status registers by writing 0xffffffff, reads DMA interrupt status again, and clears the HSS autoreg interrupt at 0xE68C2050. The test completes with wait_on(2000) and finish(0).
